counterfactual_review.summary: Conditional pathways contain separately observable supporting and disconfirming evidence without invented scenario probabilities.

pipeline_validation.summary: Manual reproduction of editorial-depth and visual grammar criteria, sources/hosts, table presence and exact bilingual chart number parity. Full npm CI build and domain HTTP deployment remain separate.

contrary_evidence: Early Monday Asian rebound does not reverse prior week selloff or establish Monday full-session closes.
US strong payroll may reduce recession fears while tightening expected policy, with no actual new FOMC decision.
Falling Brent future quote does not document delivered cargo normalization.
China PMI 49.3 and US +165k jobs reflect different economies and statistical objects.
limitations: 9 Nov early Asian market figures are intraday not market closes.
Friday oil settlement and Monday indicative futures price cannot be treated as equivalent full-day closes.
US October CPI is scheduled Nov10 and is not observed.
Reported tanker threats and political statements are not physically quantified shipping interruptions.
Prepared and QA-documented within the same assisted session, not independently checked by a separate human editor.
Full deployment is not established by an approval record.
notes: SHA-bound factual/editorial verification, source vintage and numbers with stated limitations. Documented automated/assisted review, not an independent human auditor. Publication and CI are separate.
